messages:
Marta L.: Quick heads-up — canary for the new timebox-packer finished (12% traffic, 6h window). Short summary: p99 latency down ~22% on chat-small workloads, overall token cost ~15% lower. No user-facing errors. We'll expand if no flags. :party:

perf-bot: ```
CANARY SUMMARY (timebox-packer)
workload: chat-small (avg seq 280)
baseline: p50=46ms p95=170ms p99=430ms cost= $12.5 / 1M tokens
canary:   p50=36ms p95=132ms p99=335ms cost= $10.6 / 1M tokens
delta:    p50 -21% p95 -22% p99 -22% cost -15%
canary-id: canary-1939876543-a
notes: stable across batch sizes 1..16, minor p50 jitter in eu-west-1 (see below)
```

Ryan P.: Nice numbers. Question: what about long-sequence tails (>4k tokens)? Any regressions or mem usage spikes?

Marta L.: We ran a long-seq subset (avg 6.2k). p99 increased by ~4ms vs baseline (within noise). Memory looks fine — added a per-request cap so timebox packing skips for seq>8k. Config we used:

```yaml
timebox_packer:
  enabled: true
  time_window_ms: 12   # tradeoff: latency vs packing efficiency
  max_seq_for_packing: 8192
  fallback: serial_pack
  metrics_labels: ["tb_v1_canary"]
```

Anna W.: Observability note — saw a short p50 jitter in eu-west-1 at 03:42 UTC when we swapped routers. Was correlated with a single host transient CPU steal; not related to packer logic. Pulled traces: good span coverage. :eyes: Link: https://console/reports/perf/1939876543

Jamal S.: Also saw a small spike in memcached timeouts (03:41:58..03:42:05) during canary switching. Likely infra flake. No failed requests reached user error thresholds, but tagging for oncall to watch next 6h.

Marta L.: Good catch — we already set automatic fallback to baseline when cache timeouts > 2% in a 1m window. Plan: promote to 25% traffic in 24h if no new flags. Will open rollout PR with rollback playbook.

Ryan P.: One more ask: can we add a histogram of packed-batch-sizes to the perf dashboard? Will help tune time_window_ms per region.

perf-bot: ```
DASHBOARD METRICS (sample)
- packed_batch_size: mean=3.6 median=3 p95=7
- pack_success_rate: 99.3%
- fallback_rate: 0.7%
- cost_saved_estimate: 15.4% (projected)
```

Marta L.: Thanks — created GH issue #1429 to add region split and dynamic window suggestion. If you see anything off after the 25% bump ping me directly. :thumbsup:

Jamal S.: I'll keep an eye on memcache alerts and post if anything repeats.

Anna W.: LGTM. Great win for small/latency-sensitive flows.

Marta L.: Closing notes: rollout checklist in the PR, regen canary tags, and plan to run long-seq nightly job to monitor drift. Cheers! :rocket:
